column1: #mapping_set_description: Schema-level mappings between the FINOS Common Architecture Language Model (CALM 1.2) and the ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Information Security Management System LinkML schema. CALM's Control concept corresponds to the ISO 27001 Annex A SecurityControl; the Architecture document root relates to the ISMS top-level container; Nodes are information assets; EvidenceDocument relates to documented information used in audits.

column7: A CALM Control is a named, domain-scoped control requirement with a requirement-url and config; an ISO 27001 SecurityControl represents an Annex A control instance with applicability and implementation status - both model a bounded security safeguard.

A CALM ControlRequirement specifies a control schema with id, name, and description; ISO 27001 SecurityControl captures the same structured representation for an Annex A control - effectively the requirement template.

A CALM Architecture document describes the full set of nodes, relationships, and controls for a system; the ISMS is the broader management framework governing those controls - CALM captures the technical architecture inside an ISMS scope.

A CALM Node models a logical or physical architecture element (system, service, database, network); an ISO 27001 Asset is any item of value to the organisation including software, hardware, and information - the concepts align when the CALM node is a managed IT asset.

A CALM EvidenceDocument links evidence artefacts to a control configuration; ISO 27001 DocumentedInformation is the base class for all ISMS records required as evidence - both serve as compliance evidence containers.

A CALM Flow maps business transactions across architecture relationships; an ISO 27001 OperationalProcedure defines an operational control step - both describe ordered activity sequences over system elements.

A CALM Decorator attaches supplementary cross-cutting information to architecture elements; an ISO 27001 MonitoringItem records an observation about a control or asset - both annotate elements with out-of-band information.
A CALM Timeline records time-stamped architecture moments; an ISO 27001 ManagementReview captures a periodic review snapshot of ISMS effectiveness - both record point-in-time assessments.
